description: This file contains the implementation of the AesGcm class, a polyfill for AES-GCM encryption and decryption, including methods for encrypting and decrypting data, initializing authentication, and handling string operations. It provides cryptographic functionality specific to AES-GCM with certain limitations, such as supported nonce and tag sizes.

classes.name: AesGcm
classes.description: Provides methods for AES-GCM encryption and decryption as a PHP polyfill, including handling of cryptographic operations, key validation, and string manipulation for cryptographic processes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an AesGcm instance with a given key, key size, and block size, validating inputs accordingly.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Performs AES-GCM encryption on plaintext, generating ciphertext and authentication tag, with support for additional authenticated data.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Performs AES-GCM decryption on ciphertext, verifying the authentication tag before returning plaintext.

methods.name: gmacInit
methods.description: Initializes the GMAC object for authentication, combining nonce and key.

methods.name: strlen
methods.description: Determines the length of a string, using the appropriate PHP function based on environment.

methods.name: substr
methods.description: Returns a substring of a string, using the appropriate PHP function based on environment.
